'''Lara Notsil''' was a farmgirl on [[Aldivy]] who was killed when Admiral [[Apwar Trigit]] bombarded her home of [[New Oldtown]] in response to the farming community's refusal to provide him with supplies. Few records existed about Lara Notsil or any of the other slain New Oldtown residents. For this reason, [[Gara Petothel]], an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent, modified Notsil's records and stole her identity, which she used to escape the destruction of Trigit's [[Implacable (Star Destroyer)/Legends|''Implacable'']] and later as a [[Wraith Squadron]] pilot. Lara Notsil had a brother named [[Tavin Notsil]].
